title.en: An Act to Provide for a Public Hospital in the City of Iligan and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Provide for a Public Hospital in the City of Iligan and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2727_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be in the City of Iligan a public hospital, to be known as the Iligan City Hospital. The site of said hospital shall be determined by a board of five members, namely, the Director of Health Services or his duly authorized representative who shall act as chairman, the City Mayor, the City Engineer, and two members of the Municipal Board of said city to be designated by the City Mayor.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-one. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
